messages:
ashley: FYI nightly eval failed big on long_takehome_20k set, starting ~2028-12-10 run. 99th pct prompt truncation + some instrs dropped mid-gen.
kevin: ugh. repro? Is this with v2 quant or the new q5-mixed?
maria: it's the q4-mishmash we onboarded last week: redwood/open-13b-q4-mix@rev_2028-11-30. Nightly diff shows spike in 'missing instruction' at 8k+ prefix.
ashley: failing example (trimmed):
```
PROMPT: [INSTR] Summarize following policy and then follow steps A,B,C...
MODEL OUT: "Step A: ...
Step B: ...
" <sudden stop> then model resumes with unrelated chatter, doesn't execute Step C
```
kevin: can you paste kv cache debug dump around the breakpoint? maybe prefetch offset misalign.
ashley: pasted minimal kv trace below (anonymized):
```
KV_TRACE: session_id=xyz slot0: seq_start=0 seq_end=8191 next_offset=8192
KV_PREFETCH: hdr_seq=8176 hdr_len=64 payload_len=1024 -> write_ptr=0x7ff...
OBSERVE: after token 8200, kv_read returned slot0 idx=64 but seqnum=0 (unexpected)
```
elaine: that looks like prefetch window overlapped with eviction. Could be our prefetcher using absolute offsets instead of relative session anchor.
maria: I ran a quick local replay with the same model & inputs, enabled kv_checks, got intermittent mismatches — sometimes the read returns older block. Repro rate ~20% on my workstation.
kevin: can we correlate with GC/evict logs on runtime? maybe autoshutdown or batch coalescing triggers window shift.
ashley: attaching runtime extract (small):
```
2028-12-10T03:12:04.123Z [runtime] evict prefix session=xyz anchor=8000 keep_until=8160
2028-12-10T03:12:04.125Z [runtime] prefetch session=xyz anchor=8200 length=512 -> target_slot=0
```
elaine: aha, evict at 8000 then prefetch anchored at 8200 targeted slot 0 which overlapped the evicted range. race.
maria: hypothesis: when prefetched chunk wraps, we compute slot index modulo pool_size but forget to advance session_seq base. leads to stale reads.
kevin: priority: reproduce reliably, then bisect commit range in runtime prefetcher (last change was 2028-11-29 PR #432).
ashley: infra-bot: can we schedule a canary run with logging enabled for 1000 longctx sequences?
infra-bot: scheduled canary job: canary-longctx-2028-12-10-ashley, 1 GPU, logs -> s3://redwood-ci/canaries/20281210/abc123
elaine: quick patch idea: treat prefetch anchor > evict_anchor as new base and bump slot_base by pool_size on wrap. Will open draft.
maria: also need unit that simulates wrap+evict race. I can add a deterministic test to runtime-cache-tests.
kevin: action items: (1) ashley - attach full failing prompt + kv dump to ticket; (2) elaine - draft fix and small canary; (3) maria - test harness + repro script; (4) ops - run canary and collect traces.
ashley: added ticket RW-3145 with artifacts and links to canary.
deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime/pretech-fix-canary @canary-2028-12-10 (sha: b7f3ac)
maria: repro script: `scripts/repro_longctx_kv.py --session xyz --repeat 200` reproduces failure locally at ~18% on my laptop. sharing gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/ml/kv-repro-2028
kevin: if canary shows reduction to <1% we'll roll to staging and run full nightly. If not, revert to previous q4-mix model for nightly evals.
ashley: thanks team. will update RW-3145 with canary outcome. :thumbsup:
